name: English
intro_1: A front-end developer with a passion for building clean, engaging, and user-focused web experiences.
intro_2: In 2021, I decided to learn cooking. At first, I only had a hint of hunger for Italian food, so I took Gordon Ramsay’s MasterClass on MasterClass. With pasta, sauce, and cheese, I cooked my very first dinner and thought, “Hey, I might actually be good at this.” But reality hit — online videos alone weren’t enough. I joined a six-month culinary program, mastered baking, grilling, frying, and boiling, and made dishes ranging from breakfast omelets to lunch sandwiches to midnight snacks.
intro_3: In 2026, I started overthinking pop culture. At first, I only had a tiny curiosity about Taylor Swift and Lady Gaga, so I opened a fan forum and thought, “Okay, this is harmless.” But reality hit — the comments alone weren’t enough. I joined a six-month rabbit hole, mastered Eras Tour lore, Mayhem theories, and red-carpet timelines, and built mental charts ranging from award-show hugs to secret-collab rumors.
intro_4: At first, I was totally lost — like a beginner trying to play every song at once. Things only started to sound good when I began writing my own riffs. With YouTube as my guitar teacher, I could learn, practice, and polish chords faster. My first original song? A simple but catchy tune inspired by classic rock bands like The Beatles — fully composed, recorded, and shared by me via SoundCloud.
intro_5: Today, I’m scrolling the sweet spot where Taylor Swift meets Lady Gaga, aiming to read drama with a little curiosity and craft gossip that makes people want to stick around a bit longer.
